steps: Toast kataifi pastry on stovetop until golden and crisp
Grind toasted kataifi with pistachios into a coarse paste
Blend paste with sugar and oil until smooth and spreadable
Blend vanilla ice cream with milk until smooth and slushy
Pour mixture into a chilled bowl or cup
Drizzle generous amount of pistachio cream over the ice cream
Top with extra crushed toasted kataifi for crunch

swaps.why: Stall lacks chocolate moulds; spoon allows direct drizzling and serving

hooks: Crunchy pistachio cream meets soft ice cream
Skip the line, grab this local twist
plan.caption: Ah Seng Drinks Stall brings you a new treat: pistachio cream drizzled over blended ice cream. The creamy nutty sauce pairs with crunchy toasted kataifi for a satisfying texture. Perfect with your Kopi or Teh Tarik. Come try it this week! #SingaporeEats #AhSengDrinks
plan.offer: Buy any drink, get pistachio ice cream add-on for $1
